storyCards.headline: This Is Why I'm Hot: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Mims's "This Is Why I'm Hot" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. Music Is My Savior is the debut studio album by American rapper Mims.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.

This Is Why I'm Hot was released in 2007.
